"''With what ship? I'm taking mine.|Osha Aniseya and the Stranger, regarding Mae|}} The '''''Exile II''''' was a sleek [[starship]] owned by the [[Sith]] known as [[the Stranger]] during the [[High Republic Era]] and used by his acolyte, the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya]], on her [[Mae's quest|quest]] to [[Hunting|hunt]] down four [[Jedi]] who had been [[Mission to Brendok|stationed]] on her [[homeworld]] of [[Brendok]]. In the ''Exile II'', the [[assassin]] traveled to the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], where she [[Indara's murder|killed]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]], and the world [[Olega]], where she [[Skirmish on Olega|killed]] Master [[Torbin]]. She and her associate "Qimir," secretly her [[Sith Master]], later traveled to the planet [[Khofar]] on the vessel to [[Mission to Khofar|hunt]] down Master [[Kelnacca]]. The Stranger subsequently used the ''Exile II'' to bring Aniseya's [[Aniseya family|sister]], [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha "Osha" Aniseya]], to the planet [[Bal'demnic]] where he operated. The pair followed Mae to the planet [[Brendok]] in the ''Exile II'', where Osha chose to train with the Stranger. ==Description== {{Quote|I'd start swimming if you want to make it to the ship before sundown.|The Stranger, to Osha Aniseya|{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}}}} [[File:ExileII-Day.png|thumb|left|280px|The ''Exile II'' landing on Khofar.]] The ''Exile II'' was a [[starship]] with a sleek design, measuring 60.2 [[meter]]s in length.{{Databank|exile-ii|Exile II}} The vessel had a rectangular shape, featuring two [[cockpit]]s within its aft fuselage—allowing two individuals to [[pilot]] the vessel—that sat on either side of a ball [[turret]], as well a smaller bridged outboard front section. Two downward-pointing fins were situated at the front of the ship,{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} while two similar fins pointed upward at the back. The ''Exile II'' was equipped with a single [[engine]] at its rear. The vessel possessed a communications system between its two cockpits and had the ability for one cockpit to deactivate the power of the other. The cockpits each featured a display screen that could show a topographical map, including the location of other vessels. The ''Exile II'' also featured lights on its exterior.{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} When landing, the ''Exile II'' descended smoothly and would come to rest on its front fins and a landing gear that extended from the underside of its back section.{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} ==History== ===Hunting the Jedi=== {{Quote|I can get us out of this city.''"
"''And go where?''"
"''Khofar.|"Qimir" and Mae Aniseya, on traveling from Olega to Khofar|}} [[File:ExileII-RevengeJustice.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Exile II'' docked on Olega]] During the [[High Republic Era]], the ''Exile II'' was owned by the [[Sith]] known as [[the Stranger]].{{Databank|qimir|The Stranger (alias "Qimir")}} Based out of an [[The Stranger's island|island]] on the [[planet]] [[Bal'demnic]],{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-10-24.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-10-24}} the Stranger trained an acolyte, the [[Sith assassin]]{{GermanFanCite|114|Star Wars: The Acolyte: There Are Always Four – No More, No Less…|''Star Wars: The Acolyte'': There Are Always Four – No More, No Less…}} [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya]].{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Aniseya utilized the ''Exile II'' after being [[Mae's quest|tasked]] by her [[Sith Master|Master]] to [[Hunting|hunt]] down and [[Death|kill]] four [[Jedi]] who had been [[Mission to Brendok|stationed]] on her [[homeworld]] of [[Brendok]] sixteen [[Standard year|years]] prior. The [[assassin]] took the ''Exile II'' to{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} the planet{{Databank|ueda|Ueda}} [[Ueda]], leaving it on a cliff edge near a [[Point Ueda|village]], where she [[Indara's murder|killed]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]]. She later returned to the Stranger's planet to meet with her Master before departing for the planet{{Databank|olega|Olega}} [[Olega]], where she parked the ship on the coastline near the [[Olega City|city]] containing the world's [[Olega Jedi temple|Jedi temple]]. On Olega, Aniseya [[Skirmish on Olega|killed]] Master [[Torbin]] with the assistance of her associate "Qimir"—who, unknown to Aniseya, was her Master,{{Acolyte|Night}}—but was confronted by a group of Jedi that included Master [[Sol]], another target of hers. The next [[Local day|morning]], Aniseya escaped Olega with Qimir's help, and the pair [[Mission to Khofar|traveled]] aboard the ''Exile II'' to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Khofar]], where the [[Wookiee]] Jedi Master [[Kelnacca]] [[Kelnacca's shelter|resided]]. After landing the ''Exile II'' in a valley, Aniseya and Qimir disembarked and prepared for a journey into Khofar's [[forest]]s. When Aniseya, having learned of the survival of her [[Aniseya family|sister]], [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha "Osha" Aniseya]], decided to turn herself in to Kelnacca, the Stranger murdered the Wookiee himself and attacked the Jedi team who had visited Khofar to catch Mae, killing all but Sol. ===In pursuit of the past=== {{Quote|So you're really not going to tell me where we're going.''"
"''We go together or we don't go at all.|The Stranger and Osha Aniseya|}} The Stranger later used the ''Exile II'' to bring Osha—who had been left behind after Mae knocked her unconscious and switched [[clothing]] to pose as her sister—from Khofar to the planet on which he was based, parking the vessel on a rocky landing pad connected by a walkway that led a short distance across the [[ocean]] to his island. After Osha confronted the Stranger—by which point the tide was in, isolating the ship from the island—the latter suggested that she could either start swimming if she wished to reach the ''Exile II'' before sundown or wait until the tide was out. Osha contemplated the vessel, ultimately choosing to remain on the planet. [[File:StrangerExileII-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|left|340px|The Stranger in the ''Exile II'' on Brendok.]] After Osha learned of Mae's location on Brendok, she wished to go after her sister, but the Stranger noted that he intended to take his own ship; the pair decided to go together, although Osha refused to reveal their destination before their arrival. Osha and the Stranger crossed over to the now-accessible ''Exile II'', departing the planet and traveling to Brendok. As the pair piloted the vessel into Brendok's [[atmosphere]], the Stranger attempted to speak to Osha, but the latter deactivated his cockpit's power. Noticing on her display that Sol and Mae had already arrived, Osha headed for a landing site near the [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] where the sisters had formerly resided with a [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es. After Osha killed Sol in anger and chose to train with the Stranger, the pair departed Brendok in the ''Exile II'', returning to the planet where the Stranger resided. ==Commanders and crew== The ''Exile II'' was owned by the Sith known as the Stranger and utilized by Mae Aniseya during her missions, with the ship providing safe passage between her destinations. The Stranger, in his guise as Qimir, accompanied her in the ''Exile II'' while traveling to Khofar, and later reclaimed the ''Exile II'' to transport Osha to his planet. The pair later flew the ship together to Brendok and back. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The other part shot on Madeira was at the beginning when they land on Olega. I made a 3-foot miniature in the art department of the spaceship, which is in the foreground before you see the city.|Kevin Jenkins|{{WebCite|url=https://arstechnica.com/culture/2024/06/star-wars-behind-the-scenes-creating-the-unique-aesthetic-of-the-acolyte|text=Star Wars behind the scenes: Creating the unique aesthetic of ''The Acolyte''|author=Jennifer Ouellette|date=2024-06-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Ars Technica|''Ars Technica'']]|archivedate=20240704230817}}}} [[File:ExileIIMiniature-TheAcolyte.jpg|thumb|right|290px|The miniature for the ''Exile II'' on location in Madeira for "Revenge / Justice"]] The ''Exile II'' first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]" and "[[Revenge / Justice]]," the first and second episodes of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired simultaneously on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Prior to the release of ''The Acolyte'', the vessel was first depicted in a trailer for the series on [[May 4]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|6tzur6JrUEA|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} The ''Exile II'' was later identified in an entry on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]], released alongside the episode guide for the series' fourth episode, "[[Day (episode)|Day]]," on [[June 19]], 2024.{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-4-day-episode-guide|text="Day" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} A three-foot miniature of the vessel was created by production designer [[Kevin Jenkins]] and the art department. For the shot in the opening of "Revenge / Justice" where the ''Exile II'' is parked on Olega, the miniature was filmed on location on the [[Wikipedia:Portugal|Portuguese]] island of [[Wikipedia:Madeira|Madeira]]. ==Appearances== *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st|"[[Revenge / Justice]]"}} *{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} *{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} *{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|6tzur6JrUEA|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|QIrF3elBNS8|The Acolyte | Evolve | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|zotV8szyesw|The Acolyte | Creating the Acolyte | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|-caL_Fhsr4U|The Acolyte | Power of Two | New Episodes Tuesdays on Disney+}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-music-michael-abels-interview|text=Scoring ''The Acolyte'': Composing for the Jedi, the Witches, and the Many Moods of the Stranger}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|DmI8K7Cz0jg|The Characters of The Acolyte | Now Streaming on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|8S-5MC_uxVc|The Acolyte | The Stunts of The Acolyte | Disney+}} {{Video}} *[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] *{{Databank|exile-ii|Exile II}} {{1stID|''Exile II''}} *{{Databank|qimir|The Stranger (alias "Qimir")}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Exile II}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Exilio II |fr=Exile II |ka=განდევნა II }} [[Category:Santhe Corporation products]] [[Category:Starships of the Order of the Sith Lords]]
